title: Workiva connector (Beta)
body:
The Workiva connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the **Previews** page.

The connector ingests audit activity, users, and roles from your Workiva organization into Databricks. Authentication uses Workiva OAuth2 client credentials.

See [Workiva connector](/aws/en/ingestion/lakeflow-connect/workiva).
